drivers: Fibonacci-like additive rule (each term = sum of two previous) is a well-known, commonly encountered pattern
Small numbers and trivial arithmetic; 80 s is ample
Distractors 16 and 17 catch people trying difference-based rules (+2,+1,+3,+4 → next +5/+6 gives 16/17), which draws lower-ability test-takers
Short series (5 terms) gives limited confirmation, but the Lucas-sequence start 1,3,4,7 is distinctive
